github.title: GitHub App
github.notConfiguredHint: Set GITHUB_APP_ENABLED, GITHUB_APP_ID and GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE above. See docs/github.md for the App to create and the exact permissions it needs.

remove.title: Remove this container?
remove.description: The container goes. Volumes, networks and images stay exactly where they are.
remove.volumesKept: They are kept. The panel never removes a volume, and never runs a prune.
remove.notAllowed: The panel does not remove its own infrastructure

apply.title: Apply and restart
apply.barPending: Saved settings are not running yet.
apply.barManual: Apply them on the host with:

unavailable.disabled: Set PORTTA_APPLY=true in the host's .env, then run the command once.
unavailable.refused: This host refuses to apply from the panel: {{reason}}.
unavailable.notPrepared: PORTTA_APPLY is already on; the applier is not prepared yet. Run the command once on the host.

apply.confirmDescription: Portta recreates its own containers so these saved values take effect.
apply.confirmPanel: This panel is one of them: it goes offline for a few seconds and comes back on its own.
apply.confirmProjects: Your projects are not touched. Only Portta's own containers are recreated, and the shared network stays as it is.
apply.confirmMoves: A pending setting changes where this panel answers, so this tab will not reconnect on its own.
apply.confirmKeepTab: Keep this tab open while it runs.
apply.confirmBuild: This host builds its own images, so the apply includes a Docker build. The first one can take several minutes.
apply.keepTabOpen: Do not close this tab. The panel comes back on its own.

phase.waiting: The panel is restarting. Waiting for it to answer…
phase.reconnected: Done. The saved settings are running.
phase.timeout: The panel has not answered yet.

apply.reloadWhy: This page still shows what the previous process answered with.
apply.failedExit: The applier exited with code {{code}}. Nothing was rolled back.
apply.failedHint: Run it on the host to see the whole output:
apply.timeoutBody: The panel has not answered for {{time}}. It may still be starting. Reload the page, or finish it on the host:
